expertise.title: Boat survey
expertise.description: Know the boat's real condition before you buy, with an independent surveyor's report.

sections.b: Hull, engine, electrics and papers are inspected on site; hidden defects surface before you buy.
The report is added to the Boat Logbook as a verified record and the listing gets a "surveyed" badge.

broker.title: Sell with a broker
broker.description: Let a professional sell your boat: the right price, the right buyer, a smooth transfer.

sections.b: Apply in the app; the broker handles pricing, the listing, buyer talks and the transfer.
Follow your case step by step in the app.

logbook.title: Boat Logbook
logbook.description: Maintenance, repair and survey history that changes hands with your boat.
logbook.cta: Create your logbook in the app

sections.b: Jobs done through the platform and survey reports become verified logbook records.
A logbook summary appears on the listing; buyers trust the boat's history.

usta.title: Boat technicians and service
usta.description: Verified technicians for engines, electrics, paint, gelcoat and more.

sections.b: Payment is held safely until the job is done and approved.
Jobs done through the app are added to the boat's logbook as verified records.

kaptan.title: Hire a skipper
kaptan.description: Certified, rated skippers by the day or week.

sections.b: Skippers' certificates are verified; choose by ratings and reviews.
Payment is held safely until the service is complete.

ustaJoin.title: Join as a technician
ustaJoin.description: Reach boat owners and get paid securely.

sections.b: Get the app, log in with your phone, verify your identity and upload your professional documents.
Tax certificate or trade certificate; business and insurance documents if you have them.
Reviews and ratings bring you forward; your jobs are recorded in the boat's logbook.

kaptanJoin.title: Join as a skipper
kaptanJoin.description: Find daily and weekly skipper jobs.

sections.b: Get the app, log in with your phone, verify your identity and upload your documents.
Yacht master or amateur sailor certificate and a valid health report.

about.title: About us
about.description: teknemisatıyorum brings buying, selling and the whole life of a boat into one place.

sections.b: Listings, surveys, brokerage, technicians and skippers, plus the Boat Logbook, on one platform.
Trust is the biggest question when buying a boat; verified records and independent surveys answer it.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Write to us with questions or partnership ideas.

kvkk.title: Privacy notice (KVKK)
kvkk.description: How your personal data is processed and your rights.

sections.b: teknemisatıyorum.com (legal name and address to be added).
Identity, contact, boat and listing details, transaction and payment records, device and session data.
Running membership, listing and service processes, security, fraud prevention and legal obligations.
To the payment institution, hosting provider and authorities, only as needed.
You may access, correct, delete and object to processing of your data and claim compensation.
National ID numbers are stored encrypted, photo location data is removed, documents open via short-lived links.
Your number is hidden on listings; it shows only if you share it or enable it in settings.
You can download a copy of your data and delete your account in the app.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: Rules that apply when using the platform.

sections.b: Listings are reviewed before going live; misleading or non-compliant listings are rejected.
Featured, Urgent and Bump are paid services; their time starts at purchase.
The boat's price is paid between the parties; the platform is not a party to the sale.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: Which cookies we use and why.

sections.b: Needed for sessions and to store your cookie choice; they can't be turned off.
Used only with your consent. No analytics tool is in use right now.
